import re, math

fn='/app/text.gcode'

word_re=re.compile(r'([A-Za-z])([-+]?\d*\.?\d+)')
cur_obj=None
pos={'X':0.0,'Y':0.0,'Z':0.0}
relative_e=True
stats=defaultdict(lambda: {'n':0,'xmin':1e9,'xmax':-1e9,'ymin':1e9,'ymax':-1e9,'zmin':1e9,'zmax':-1e9,'zs':defaultdict(int),'len':0.0,'e':0.0})
segments=[]
for lineno,line in enumerate(open(fn, errors='replace'),1):
    line=line.split(';',1)[0].strip()
    if not line: continue
    m=cmd_re.match(line)
    if not m: continue
    typ,num,rest=m.group(1),float(m.group(2)),m.group(3) or ''
    words={k:float(v) for k,v in word_re.findall(rest)}
    if typ=='M' and num==486 and 'S' in words:
        cur_obj=int(words['S'])

    if typ=='M' and num==83:
        relative_e=True
        continue
    if typ=='M' and num==82:
        relative_e=False
        continue
    if typ=='G' and num in (0,1):
        new={axis:words.get(axis,pos[axis]) for axis in ('X','Y','Z')}
        e=words.get('E')
        moved=any(abs(new[a]-pos[a])>1e-7 for a in ('X','Y','Z'))
        de=(e if relative_e else (e if e is not None else 0)) if e is not None else 0
        if moved and de>0 and cur_obj is not None:
            d=math.dist((pos['X'],pos['Y'],pos['Z']),(new['X'],new['Y'],new['Z']))
            s=stats[cur_obj]
            s['n']+=1; s['len']+=d; s['e']+=de
            s['xmin']=min(s['xmin'],new['X'],pos['X']); s['xmax']=max(s['xmax'],new['X'],pos['X'])
            s['ymin']=min(s['ymin'],new['Y'],pos['Y']); s['ymax']=max(s['ymax'],new['Y'],pos['Y'])
            s['zmin']=min(s['zmin'],new['Z'],pos['Z']); s['zmax']=max(s['zmax'],new['Z'],pos['Z'])
            s['zs'][round(new['Z'],3)]+=1
            if cur_obj==0:
                segments.append((lineno,pos['X'],pos['Y'],pos['Z'],new['X'],new['Y'],new['Z'],de))
        pos=new

for obj,s in sorted(stats.items()):
    print(f"OBJECT {obj}: segments={s['n']} length={s['len']:.1f}mm extrusion={s['e']:.1f}mm")
    print(f"  X={s['xmin']:.3f}..{s['xmax']:.3f}  Y={s['ymin']:.3f}..{s['ymax']:.3f}  Z={s['zmin']:.3f}..{s['zmax']:.3f}")

for s in segments:
    w=max(s[7],1e-9)
    pts.extend([(s[1],s[2],s[3],w),(s[4],s[5],s[6],w)])
mean=[sum(p[i]*p[3] for p in pts)/sum(p[3] for p in pts) for i in range(3)]
C=[[sum((p[i]-mean[i])*(p[j]-mean[j])*p[3] for p in pts)/sum(p[3] for p in pts) for j in range(3)] for i in range(3)]
# Jacobi symmetric eigensolver
A=[row[:] for row in C]; V=[[1.0 if i==j else 0.0 for j in range(3)] for i in range(3)]
for sweep in range(50):
    off=sum(A[i][j]**2 for i in range(3) for j in range(i+1,3))
    if off < 1e-18: break
    for p in range(2):
        for q in range(p+1,3):
            if abs(A[p][q]) < 1e-18: continue
            theta=(A[q][q]-A[p][p])/(2*A[p][q])
            t=(1 if theta>=0 else -1)/(abs(theta)+math.sqrt(theta*theta+1))
            c=1/math.sqrt(t*t+1); s=t*c
            for k in range(3):
                akp=A[k][p]; akq=A[k][q]
                A[k][p]=c*akp-s*akq; A[k][q]=s*akp+c*akq
            for k in range(3):
                apk=A[p][k]; aqk=A[q][k]
                A[p][k]=c*apk-s*aqk; A[q][k]=s*apk+c*aqk
            for k in range(3):

                V[k][p]=c*vkp-s*vkq; V[k][q]=s*vkp+c*vkq
ev=[(A[i][i],[V[0][i],V[1][i],V[2][i]]) for i in range(3)]
ev.sort(reverse=True)
print('mean:',*[f'{x:.6f}' for x in mean])
for n,(val,v) in enumerate(ev):
    print(f'axis {n}: variance={val:.6f}, std={math.sqrt(val):.6f}, vector=({v[0]:.6f}, {v[1]:.6f}, {v[2]:.6f})')
axes=[ev[0][1],ev[1][1],ev[2][1]]

import re, math
fn='/app/text.gcode'
cmd_re=re.compile(r'^([GM])(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)(?:\s+(.*))?$')
word_re=re.compile(r'([A-Za-z])([-+]?\d*\.?\d+)')
pos={'X':0.0,'Y':0.0,'Z':0.0}; cur=None; segs=[]
for line in open(fn,errors='replace'):
    line=line.split(';',1)[0].strip(); m=cmd_re.match(line)
    if not m: continue
    typ,num,rest=m.group(1),float(m.group(2)),m.group(3) or ''
    words={k:float(v) for k,v in word_re.findall(rest)}
    if typ=='M' and num==486 and 'S' in words: cur=int(words['S']); continue
    if typ=='G' and num in (0,1):
        new={a:words.get(a,pos[a]) for a in ('X','Y','Z')}; de=words.get('E',0.0)
        if cur==0 and de>0 and any(abs(new[a]-pos[a])>1e-7 for a in ('X','Y','Z')):
            segs.append((pos['X'],pos['Y'],pos['Z'],new['X'],new['Y'],new['Z']))
        pos=new

# Principal axes from /tmp/pca_pure.py.
mean=[129.795530,112.372980,32.261357]
axes=[[0.866572,0.355702,0.350043],[-0.394770,0.917689,0.044774]]
def proj(p): return [sum((p[i]-mean[i])*a[i] for i in range(3)) for a in axes]
ps=[(proj((s[0],s[1],s[2])),proj((s[3],s[4],s[5]))) for s in segs]
vals=[q for pair in ps for q in pair]
u0=min(q[0] for q in vals); u1=max(q[0] for q in vals)
v0=min(q[1] for q in vals); v1=max(q[1] for q in vals)

# 6 pixels/mm, with a modest dilation representing extrusion width.
S=6.0
W=int(math.ceil((u1-u0)*S))+1; H=int(math.ceil((v1-v0)*S))+1
pix=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
def mark(x,y,r=1):
    for yy in range(max(0,y-r),min(H,y+r+1)):
        for xx in range(max(0,x-r),min(W,x+r+1)):
            pix[yy][xx]=1
for a,b in ps:
    ax=round((a[0]-u0)*S); ay=round((a[1]-v0)*S)
    bx=round((b[0]-u0)*S); by=round((b[1]-v0)*S)
    dx=abs(bx-ax); dy=-abs(by-ay); sx=1 if ax<bx else -1; sy=1 if ay<by else -1; err=dx+dy
    while True:
        mark(ax,ay,1)
        if ax==bx and ay==by: break
        e2=2*err
        if e2>=dy: err+=dy; ax+=sx
        if e2<=dx: err+=dx; ay+=sy

# Downsample 6x6 source pixels to one terminal character (about 1 mm wide x 0.5 mm tall).
def render(flip_x=False,flip_y=False,chunk=100):
    CW=6; CH=3  # source pixels per character; S/CW=1 mm, S/CH=2 mm vertically
    outw=math.ceil(W/CW); outh=math.ceil(H/CH)
    rows=[]
    for cy in range(outh):
        row=''
        for cx in range(outw):
            n=0
            for yy in range(cy*CH,min(H,(cy+1)*CH)):
                for xx in range(cx*CW,min(W,(cx+1)*CW)):
                    n+=pix[yy][xx]
            row += '#' if n>=2 else ('+' if n==1 else ' ')
        if flip_y: row=row[::-1]
        rows.append(row)
    if flip_x: rows=rows[::-1]
    # Trim blank edges.
    while rows and not rows[0].strip(): rows.pop(0)
    while rows and not rows[-1].strip(): rows.pop()
    if rows:
        lo=min(next((i for i,c in enumerate(r) if c!=' '),len(r)) for r in rows)
        hi=max(next((len(r)-i-1 for i,c in reversed(list(enumerate(r))) if c!=' '),-1) for r in rows)
        rows=[r[lo:hi+1] for r in rows]
    print(f'\n=== flip_x={flip_x} flip_y={flip_y}; plane size {u1-u0:.1f} x {v1-v0:.1f} mm; chars {max(map(len,rows),default=0)}x{len(rows)} ===')
    for start in range(0,max(map(len,rows),default=1),chunk):
        print(f'-- columns {start+1}-{min(start+chunk,max(map(len,rows),default=0))} --')
        for r in rows: print(r[start:start+chunk])
        print()

print(f'{len(segs)} extruding segments; principal-plane bounds U {u0:.3f}..{u1:.3f}, V {v0:.3f}..{v1:.3f}; raster {W}x{H}')
for fx in (False,True):
    for fy in (False,True): render(fx,fy)

Analysis: The principal-plane render is unexpectedly narrow: only about 4 characters wide despite a computed 168 mm first-axis range. This indicates either an error in the pure-Python eigensolver or that a small number of outlier segments dominated the weighted PCA. The current projection cannot yet be trusted, and the text remains unidentified.
Plan: Validate the eigensolver residuals and inspect projection occupancy histograms. Then recompute PCA using unweighted, evenly sampled segment points and compare candidate plane projections. This will reveal whether the text plane is the current first two axes or another axis pair.

exec(open('/tmp/analyze.py').read().replace("print(f\"OBJECT", "# print(f\"OBJECT").replace("print('  Z levels:',", "# print('  Z levels:',").replace("print('object 0 segments stored:',len(segments))", "pass"))
import math, statistics
# Current claimed principal axes
mean=[129.795530,112.372980,32.261357]
axes=[[0.866572,0.355702,0.350043],[-0.394770,0.917689,0.044774],[-0.305304,-0.176986,0.935663]]
pts=[]
for s in segments:
    # Sample every segment midpoint and endpoints without extrusion weighting.
    pts.extend([(s[1],s[2],s[3]),(s[4],s[5],s[6]),((s[1]+s[4])/2,(s[2]+s[5])/2,(s[3]+s[6])/2)])
def coords(axis):
    return [sum((p[i]-mean[i])*axis[i] for i in range(3)) for p in pts]
for j,a in enumerate(axes):
    d=coords(a)
    print(f'axis {j}: min={min(d):.3f} max={max(d):.3f} mean={statistics.mean(d):.3f} std={statistics.pstdev(d):.3f}')
# Occupancy in 1-mm bins for current plane axes.
for j,a in enumerate(axes[:2]):
    d=coords(a); lo=min(d); bins={}
    for x in d:
        k=int((x-lo)//1)
        bins[k]=bins.get(k,0)+1
    print(f'axis {j} occupied 1mm bins={len(bins)}; counts by bin:', ' '.join(f'{k}:{v}' for k,v in sorted(bins.items())))
# Quantiles along each axis.
for j,a in enumerate(axes):
    d=sorted(coords(a)); print('axis',j,'quantiles', [d[round(q*(len(d)-1))] for q in (0,.001,.01,.05,.1,.25,.5,.75,.9,.95,.99,.999,1)])

exec(open('/tmp/analyze.py').read().replace("print(f\"OBJECT", "# print(f\"OBJECT").replace("print('  Z levels:',", "# print('  Z levels:',").replace("print('object 0 segments stored:',len(segments))", "pass"))
import math
# Sample points uniformly by geometric segment length, ignoring extrusion weighting.
pts=[]
for s in segments:
    a=s[1:4]; b=s[4:7]; length=math.dist(a,b)
    n=max(1,math.ceil(length*4))
    for k in range(n+1):
        t=k/n
        pts.append(tuple(a[i]+t*(b[i]-a[i]) for i in range(3)))
mean=[sum(p[i] for p in pts)/len(pts) for i in range(3)]
C=[[sum((p[i]-mean[i])*(p[j]-mean[j]) for p in pts)/len(pts) for j in range(3)] for i in range(3)]
A=[r[:] for r in C]; V=[[1.0 if i==j else 0.0 for j in range(3)] for i in range(3)]
for sweep in range(100):
    off=sum(A[i][j]**2 for i in range(3) for j in range(i+1,3))
    if off < 1e-18: break
    for p in range(2):
        for q in range(p+1,3):
            if abs(A[p][q]) < 1e-18: continue
            theta=(A[q][q]-A[p][p])/(2*A[p][q])
            t=(1 if theta>=0 else -1)/(abs(theta)+math.sqrt(theta*theta+1)); c=1/math.sqrt(t*t+1); s=t*c
            for k in range(3):
                akp=A[k][p]; akq=A[k][q]; A[k][p]=c*akp-s*akq; A[k][q]=s*akp+c*akq
            for k in range(3):
                apk=A[p][k]; aqk=A[q][k]; A[p][k]=c*apk-s*aqk; A[q][k]=s*apk+c*aqk
                vkp=V[k][p]; vkq=V[k][q]; V[k][p]=c*vkp-s*vkq; V[k][q]=s*vkp+c*vkq
items=[(A[i][i], [V[0][i],V[1][i],V[2][i]]) for i in range(3)]; items.sort(reverse=True)
print('sample points',len(pts),'mean',mean)
for n,(val,v) in enumerate(items):
    d=[sum((p[i]-mean[i])*v[i] for i in range(3)) for p in pts]
    print(f'axis {n}: variance={val:.6f} std={math.sqrt(val):.6f} range={min(d):.3f}..{max(d):.3f} vector={v}')
    Av=[sum(C[i][j]*v[j] for j in range(3)) for i in range(3)]; print(' residual', [x-val*y for x,y in zip(Av,v)])

import pickle, math
paths=pickle.load(open('/tmp/closed_points.pkl','rb'))
mean=[129.795530,112.372980,32.261357]
axes=[[0.866572,0.355702,0.350043],[-0.394770,0.917689,0.044774]]
def pr(p):
    return (sum((p[i]-mean[i])*axes[0][i] for i in range(3)),
            sum((p[i]-mean[i])*axes[1][i] for i in range(3)))
segs=[]
for path in paths:
    q=[pr(p) for p in path]
    segs.extend(zip(q,q[1:]))
vals=[p for pair in segs for p in pair]
u0=min(x for x,y in vals); u1=max(x for x,y in vals)
v0=min(y for x,y in vals); v1=max(y for x,y in vals)
S=10.0
W=math.ceil((u1-u0)*S)+1; H=math.ceil((v1-v0)*S)+1
pix=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
def mark(x,y,r=2):
    for yy in range(max(0,y-r),min(H,y+r+1)):
        for xx in range(max(0,x-r),min(W,x+r+1)):
            pix[yy][xx]=1
for a,b in segs:
    ax=round((a[0]-u0)*S); ay=round((a[1]-v0)*S)
    bx=round((b[0]-u0)*S); by=round((b[1]-v0)*S)
    dx=abs(bx-ax); dy=-abs(by-ay)
    sx=1 if ax<bx else -1; sy=1 if ay<by else -1; err=dx+dy
    while True:
        mark(ax,ay)
        if ax==bx and ay==by: break
        e2=2*err
        if e2>=dy: err+=dy; ax+=sx
        if e2<=dx: err+=dx; ay+=sy

def write_pgm(fn, flip_x=False, flip_y=False, margin=50):
    a=[row[:] for row in pix]
    if flip_x: a=[row[::-1] for row in a]
    if flip_y: a=a[::-1]
    h=len(a)+2*margin; w=len(a[0])+2*margin
    with open(fn,'wb') as f:
        f.write(f'P5\n{w} {h}\n255\n'.encode())
        blank=bytearray([255])*w
        for _ in range(margin): f.write(blank)
        for row in a:
            f.write(bytearray([255]*margin))
            f.write(bytearray(0 if v else 255 for v in row))
            f.write(bytearray([255]*margin))
        for _ in range(margin): f.write(blank)
    print(fn,w,h)

for fx in (False,True):
    for fy in (False,True):
        write_pgm(f'/tmp/text_fx{int(fx)}_fy{int(fy)}.pgm',fx,fy)
PY

import pickle, math
paths=pickle.load(open('/tmp/closed_points.pkl','rb'))
mean=[129.795530,112.372980,32.261357]
axes=[[0.866572,0.355702,0.350043],[-0.394770,0.917689,0.044774]]
def pr(p):
    return (sum((p[i]-mean[i])*axes[0][i] for i in range(3)),
            sum((p[i]-mean[i])*axes[1][i] for i in range(3)))
segs=[]
for path in paths:
    q=[pr(p) for p in path]
    segs.extend(zip(q,q[1:]))
vals=[p for pair in segs for p in pair]
u0=min(x for x,y in vals); u1=max(x for x,y in vals)
v0=min(y for x,y in vals); v1=max(y for x,y in vals)
S=10.0
W=math.ceil((u1-u0)*S)+1; H=math.ceil((v1-v0)*S)+1
pix=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
def mark(x,y,r=2):
    for yy in range(max(0,y-r),min(H,y+r+1)):
        for xx in range(max(0,x-r),min(W,x+r+1)):
            pix[yy][xx]=1
for a,b in segs:
    ax=round((a[0]-u0)*S); ay=round((a[1]-v0)*S)
    bx=round((b[0]-u0)*S); by=round((b[1]-v0)*S)
    dx=abs(bx-ax); dy=-abs(by-ay)
    sx=1 if ax<bx else -1; sy=1 if ay<by else -1; err=dx+dy
    while True:
        mark(ax,ay)
        if ax==bx and ay==by: break
        e2=2*err
        if e2>=dy: err+=dy; ax+=sx
        if e2<=dx: err+=dx; ay+=sy

def write_pgm(fn, flip_x=False, flip_y=False, margin=50):

            f.write(bytearray([255]*margin))
        for _ in range(margin): f.write(blank)
    print(fn,w,h)
for fx in (False,True):

Analysis: Tesseract consistently reads the correct orientation as `flag{gcOd3 iz ch4LLenGiNg}`. This is likely leetspeak for “gcode is challenging,” so the characters OCR reported as `O`, `i`, and `z` may actually be `0`, `1`, and `2`. I need verify those ambiguous glyphs directly from the rendered image rather than rely on OCR alone.
Plan: Generate Tesseract character-level bounding boxes for the correctly oriented image. Then render each OCR-recognized character as an enlarged ASCII crop, especially the ambiguous `O`, `i`, and `z` positions. I will also OCR a projection containing all extrusion paths for cross-validation.

import re, math
fn='/app/text.gcode'
cmd=re.compile(r'^([GM])(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)(?:\s+(.*))?$')
word=re.compile(r'([A-Za-z])([-+]?\d*\.?\d+)')
pos={'X':0.,'Y':0.,'Z':0.}; obj=None; segs=[]
for line in open(fn):
    line=line.split(';',1)[0].strip(); m=cmd.match(line)
    if not m: continue
    typ,num,rest=m.group(1),float(m.group(2)),m.group(3) or ''
    w={k:float(v) for k,v in word.findall(rest)}
    if typ=='M' and num==486 and 'S' in w: obj=int(w['S']); continue
    if typ=='G' and num in (0,1):
        old=(pos['X'],pos['Y'],pos['Z']); new=tuple(w.get(a,pos[a]) for a in ('X','Y','Z'))
        if obj==0 and w.get('E',0.)>0 and math.dist(old,new)>1e-7: segs.append((old,new))
        pos=dict(zip(('X','Y','Z'),new))
mean=[129.795530,112.372980,32.261357]
axes=[[0.866572,0.355702,0.350043],[-0.394770,0.917689,0.044774]]
def pr(p): return tuple(sum((p[i]-mean[i])*axes[j][i] for i in range(3)) for j in range(2))
ps=[(pr(a),pr(b)) for a,b in segs]
vals=[p for pair in ps for p in pair]
u0=min(x for x,y in vals); u1=max(x for x,y in vals)
v0=min(y for x,y in vals); v1=max(y for x,y in vals)
S=10.; W=math.ceil((u1-u0)*S)+1; H=math.ceil((v1-v0)*S)+1
pix=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
def mark(x,y,r=2):
    for yy in range(max(0,y-r),min(H,y+r+1)):
        for xx in range(max(0,x-r),min(W,x+r+1)): pix[yy][xx]=1
for a,b in ps:
    ax=round((a[0]-u0)*S); ay=round((a[1]-v0)*S)
    bx=round((b[0]-u0)*S); by=round((b[1]-v0)*S)
    dx=abs(bx-ax); dy=-abs(by-ay); sx=1 if ax<bx else -1; sy=1 if ay<by else -1; err=dx+dy
    while True:
        mark(ax,ay)
        if ax==bx and ay==by: break
        e2=2*err
        if e2>=dy: err+=dy; ax+=sx
        if e2<=dx: err+=dx; ay+=sy
# Correct orientation: horizontal and vertical flip.
a=[row[::-1] for row in pix][::-1]
margin=50; w=len(a[0])+2*margin; h=len(a)+2*margin
with open('/tmp/all_paths.pgm','wb') as f:
    f.write(f'P5\n{w} {h}\n255\n'.encode()); blank=bytearray([255])*w
    for _ in range(margin): f.write(blank)
    for row in a:
        f.write(bytearray([255])*margin); f.write(bytearray(0 if v else 255 for v in row)); f.write(bytearray([255])*margin)
    for _ in range(margin): f.write(blank)
print('/tmp/all_paths.pgm',w,h)

def read_pgm(path):
